responsibility: Implements the language-independent pretty-printer for GCC tree nodes and declarations in a mostly C-like source syntax. It provides debug printers, generic statement/expression/declaration formatting, operator spelling and precedence handling, call-name and string rendering, function-header dumping, identifier formatting, and the shared dump_generic_node-based presentation used by diagnostics and many tree/GIMPLE dumps.
same_name_distinction: Provides the concrete language-independent tree pretty-printer implementation, including debug printers, formatting logic, operator spelling, string escaping, and function-header dumping. Unlike the header, this file contains the actual rendering code used by dumps and diagnostics.
